_meta.description: Default CostProject templates (service engagement / product development / internal optimization) for consultancy and professional-services administrations. Operator overrides per administration — these are starting-point defaults only. Amounts are indicative; actual budgets vary by sector and administration. Money values are in integer cents (e.g. 5000000 = €50.000,00).
_meta.note: administrationId left null; the repair-step phase stamps it from app config (administration_id) before persistence. Idempotent on projectNumber.

projects.name: Service Engagement Template
projects.description: Standard template for service contract delivery. Use as starting point for new client engagements (advice, retainer, integration support). Adjust totalBudget and totalEstimatedCosts per engagement scope.

projects.name: Product Development Template
projects.description: Standard template for internal product / SaaS development projects. Use as starting point for new product builds (feature work, platform investment). Adjust totalBudget and totalEstimatedCosts per release scope.

projects.name: Internal Optimization Template
projects.description: Standard template for internal optimization projects (process improvement, tooling upgrade, training). Use as starting point for back-office investments. Adjust totalBudget and totalEstimatedCosts per scope.
